title: In Rustborn, a survival crafter, you control a modular rover who awakened alone in a vast, procedurally generated world.
author: Captain_Iceblock
selftext:
Project's code is written by Claude, which I've liked working with way more than another project I already released to the public, whose code was GPT'd. The workflow I'm doing is directing Claude to write Unity tools for me with which I then sculpt terrain, models, locations, etc. manually.

Some of the game's features:

* Modular player character - swap out parts as you progress through the game
* Player is a vehicle - naturally fast and smooth traversal, exploring the large world feels fun
* Energy based gameplay loop - while health exists as Integrity stat, main player resource is Energy - required to power every single part and base building



Games that directly and indirectly inspired Rustborn, and whose influence will be felt throughout - Valheim, Death Stranding, Sons of the Forest.

More screenshots, devlogs, updates, in our [Discord](https://discord.gg/uXbNtQYAS9). Planning to launch friends and family alpha through Discord soon too. Thanks for tuning in!
